status: proposal for the reviewed amendment of 04-direction/colour-system.json; nothing in 04-direction was edited

method.renderer: Playwright Chromium 1243 (headless), npm run build dist served by astro preview :4630, DPR 1, prefers-reduced-motion: reduce (resting state), consent rejected through localStorage rds-consent=reject (what the Refuser button writes); banner measured separately on a fresh visit
method.text: All text made transparent (color, -webkit-text-fill-color, text-shadow, decoration), full-page capture in 4000 px chunks, for every visible text node the rendered Range rects (line boxes) are sampled; ratio = WCAG contrast of the computed text colour (opacity applied) against EVERY pixel in the rects, worst reported. Where the line-box test fails, the test is repeated on glyph pixels only (pixels that differ between the visible and the hidden capture, same method as 04-direction/board/D/colour-review.json) and the glyph value decides; box value kept in box_ratio_if_glyph_pass_used.
method.non_text: Focus rings: keyboard modality, computed outline width/offset/colour, ring band located by geometry, background = capture with the ring made transparent, worst per ring. Field underline: border colour against the field's own pixels and against the pixels under the field, border made transparent.
method.thresholds: 4.5:1 text, 3:1 large text (>= 24 px, or >= 18.66 px at weight >= 700) and non-text
method.limits: Text drawn inside images (baked) is not text and is not measured. The fg colour of every own text node is ink #262117 or mist-cream #ebf3f9 (2971 + 110 text runs); the only other colour is #666666 inside the client planner widget. Text over the sharp 'print' photos is not found by the pages (no caption on a photo). mix-blend logo not text. Hover states not measured (hover:hover only).

summary.note_failing: No text pair of the site's own markup fails AA at 1440 or 390 once the glyph rule is used. The only line-box failure is the home H1 .titre-nom (box 2.04 at 1440: its line box reaches the sharp print at the bottom right; glyph pixels 6.12:1, in agreement with colour-system name-on-field 6.08).
summary.third_party_widget_flagged: planner embed <select> (#666666 on the darkest sampled pixel #595959, ratio 1.22): 3 run(s) on mariage, reservations, manoir; the widget's own CSS from gadget.open-system.fr, not our markup, and the dark pixel is probably the native arrow glyph, not the text. Unverified by eye - decide in P7 with the live widget.
observations: home H1 .titre-nom at 390 measures 5.15:1 on glyph pixels (colour-system says 6.27): the built field differs slightly from the board; still passes large-text 3:1 and 4.5:1.

Inner-page header: .histoire and .nav a read 10.1-14.3:1 over every opening (ink on gites/seminaire/colonie clamps, cream on restaurant 13.63); no new colour needed, only new selectors on existing role pairs.

Header data-light is set to "restaurant" (not "dark") on the news article and "gites" etc. elsewhere; site.css only restyles data-light="dark", so the news header stays ink on mist-cream (14.27) - correct, but the value is dead.
Phone menu panel (menu open) and hover states not re-measured (already declared: nav-panel-phone 14.27).
Pill fill vs the field around it is 1.8-3.5:1 on mid-tone photo fields (advisory only: the cream label at 5.50 identifies the control).
summary.existing_pairs_reconfirmed: name 6.12 (glyph, 1440), nav on home 8.01, satellites 8.18, footer text >= 11, pill label 5.50 on rouille everywhere, ring ratios >= 6.5
